variant.basis: The completed official vector is the standalone B×+ monogram, with no separate bank name or slogan; the geometry and colors come directly from the original bank SVG. The source is wide; square-fit and small-size rendering are later gates.

candidate.rationale: Original SVG served in the operating bank's header; its completed animated frame is a recognizable standalone B×+ monogram. The matching static keyframe interpretation remains subject to full candidate fidelity, square-fit and platform checks.
